title: Sage rpg_conventions record
description: A rpg_conventions record (RpgConventionsRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another rpg_conventions record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

spellNamespace.description: The record namespace a spell made in the spellmaker is given ("custom": custom:firebolt). Its own, so nothing a player made can shadow content. (string, default "custom")

castAction.description: The button that casts the readied spell; the kit registers "Cast", a game may register its own. (string, default "Cast")
